The response contains the complete numbered English body and consolidated notes but no promulgation or subscription block. Its HTML metadata gives the erroneous eventDate 1967-12-07, while the visible heading, Latin web witness, and Acta witness give 1965-12-07; the malformed metadata does not control the work date. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.

passages.context: The complete English article and its source notes were inspected for the distinction and ordered relation between the common and ministerial priesthood, presbyters' participation in episcopal ministry, configuration to Christ the Head, and the Eucharistic consummation of priestly ministry.
passages.notes: Source note 13 cites Augustine, De civitate Dei 10.6, and note 9 cites the Roman Pontifical and earlier ordination sources. Those source-of-source relations do not imply that a publication using this article inspected Augustine, the Pontifical, or the earlier witnesses directly.

passages.context: The complete English article and its source notes were inspected for celibacy's fittingness and value, its non-derivation from the nature of priesthood, the honored married presbyterate of the Eastern Churches, and the Council's confirmation of Latin discipline.
passages.notes: The decree supplies conciliar doctrine and the discipline it confirmed in 1965. The current Latin and Eastern codes and competent particular law still control present legal requirements, exceptions, and effects.
